title: Zonal Harmonic Gravity Model
text: Calculate zonal harmonic representation of planetary gravity, 1 input, 1 output, {Planet model} sets Planetary model; {Units} sets the input units Metric, {Degree}, {Action for out-of-range input} sets the out-of-range input behavior, {Equatorial radius} sets the planetary equatorial radius, {Gravitational parameter} sets the planetary gravitational parameter and {J values} sets the zonal harmonic coefficients. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Action for out-of-range input
params.values: Out-of-range input behavior Warning (default) | Error None

params.name: Planet model
params.values: Planetary model Mercury (default) | Venus | Earth | Moon | Mars | Jupiter | Saturn | Uranus | Neptune | Custom
